 Nagaland State Lottery Sambad 3.11.2026 Today 1PM, 6PM & 8PM; Dear Sambad Lottery Live, Full Winners List
 News oi-Pooja Jaiswar By Pooja Jaiswar 
 Updated: Tuesday, November 3, 2026, 13:18 [IST]
 Add as a preferred source on Google The Nagaland state is declaring its Tuesday weekly lottery results on November 3, 2026. There are three lotteries that will be declared today namely Dear Morning 1pm, Dear Evening 6pm and Dear Night 8PM. Each of these lotteries are offering Rs 1 crore as first prize. In the total, there are six prizes each under these lotteries. The cost of per lottery ticket is Rs 6. The dear lotteries are transparent and conducted by the Directorate of Nagaland State Lotteries.
 However, the Dear Morning 1PM lottery is also called as Dear Shine, while the 6PM and 8PM lotteries are also referred as Dear Prestige and Dear Destiny. The lucky draw of all the three lotteries begins from 1pm, 6pm and 8pm, but the official results pdf are out by 1:10 pm, 6:10 pm and 8:10 pm.
